# TownofNiwot.com

> An independent community guide to Niwot, Colorado. This is not a municipal government website, Boulder County, the Niwot Election Commission or an incorporation campaign.

Last editorial review: September 2026
Canonical site: https://townofniwot.com

## Core guides

- [Niwot, Colorado community guide](https://townofniwot.com/): an overview for visitors and residents.
- [Things to do in Niwot](https://townofniwot.com/explore/): Old Town, Cottonwood Square, public art, parks and trails in walking order.
- [Niwot restaurants, shops and local services](https://townofniwot.com/eat-shop/): a categorized directory with source links and verification dates.
- [Niwot events calendar](https://townofniwot.com/events/): upcoming events checked against organizer pages.
- [Niwot community organizations and resident resources](https://townofniwot.com/community/): local groups, Boulder County services and special districts.
- [History of Niwot, Colorado](https://townofniwot.com/our-story/): a sourced history of the railroad, 1875 town plat and unincorporated community.
- [Visit Niwot](https://townofniwot.com/plan-a-visit/): directions, parking, walking, cycling, transit and accessibility notes.
- [Civic information for Niwot](https://townofniwot.com/civic/): Niwot’s civic status as an unincorporated community, the bodies that govern it, and the election pages.
- [2026 Niwot incorporation election](https://townofniwot.com/civic/incorporation-election/): neutral voter information with links to official election authorities.
- [Send a listing or correction](https://townofniwot.com/contact/): how business owners, organizers and residents submit listings, events and corrections for review.

## Editorial policy

Business listings, event dates and civic facts are published with named sources or links to the responsible organization. Time-sensitive details should be checked at the linked primary source. The certified ballot text and official election authorities control election information.
